summary:
Comprehensive Cloud Firestore Security Rules Lockdown Plan:
1. Strict Role-Based Access Control (RBAC):
   - Super Admin Master: request.auth.token.email == 'christiankanu2702@gmail.com' retains unrestricted audit/read/write across all collections.
   - User Profiles (/users/{userId}): Users can only read/write their own document; drivers can see passenger phone when assigned to a trip.
   - Trips (/trips/{tripId}):
     * Create: Authenticated passengers creating trip where request.resource.data.passengerId == request.auth.uid.
     * Read: The passenger who booked it, the driver assigned to it, drivers viewing open corridor requests ('REQUESTED'), park captains, or Super Admin.
     * Update:
       - Passengers: Can update their own trips (e.g. cancel, verify OTP, add tip/rating).
       - Drivers: Can accept trips (setting driverId = request.auth.uid) and update driverLiveLat/driverLiveLng and trip status (IN_PROGRESS, COMPLETED).
   - In-App Trip Chat (/trips/{tripId}/messages/{msgId}):
     * Only the assigned driver and booking passenger can read or post messages.
   - Bids (/bids/{bidId}):
     * Create/Update/Delete: Only the bidding driver (request.auth.uid == request.resource.data.driverId).
     * Read: The driver who placed the bid, the passenger of the target trip, or Super Admin.
   - Terminal Parks & Manifest Queues (/parks/{parkId}):
     * Read: Open to all authenticated transit participants.
     * Write: Restricted to registered Park Captains (assigned to that terminal) and Super Admin.
   - Emergency SOS Alerts (/sos_alerts/{sosId}):
     * Create: Any authenticated user in distress.
     * Read/Update: Transport regulators, ATRWAN patrol teams, and Super Admin.
2. Deployment:
   - Deploy finalized rules using deploy_firebase.
